speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
text: The SMF has got a limit consideration of $2,000 monthly income per person and that suitably limits a lot of seniors from applying for assistance.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
text: So, a lot of seniors who do not qualify under the SMF, they will have to fork out their own cash and the cost of the hearing aid is quite significant for seniors who are currently not working and they have to pay in cash.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
text: So, I would like to ask the Ministry to reconsider whether seniors can be allowed to use part of their MediSave for the purpose of hearing aid.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
text: And this is all the more important, especially given the recent studies that have shown the connection between hearing loss and dementia.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: And this is a principle that we adhere to.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: It is something that we will continue to assess.
